title: Myth flip — nobody splits the noticing (mental load, work+family juggle)
caption:
Myth: the juggle is a chore-split problem. The invisible half is the noticing and the follow-up, and that's the half women hold (Daminger, ASR 2019). Hand off a whole category, not one task.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#mentalload #invisiblelabour #workingmoms #womenshealth #fairplay

scenes.text: He did the dishes. So why is she still *fried* at 9 PM?
Neha, 38: he did the dishes, and she still *tracked* every deadline in her head.
phrases: He did bath time, no complaints.
But I'm the one who knew about the permission slip.
By 8 PM I'm running on cold chai and fumes.

scenes.text: Everybody splits the chores. Almost nobody splits the *noticing*, which is the part that wears her out.
phrases: Couples split the deciding pretty evenly.
Anticipating and monitoring stay hers (Daminger, ASR 2019).

scenes.text: Women do 76.2% of the world's unpaid care work, about *3.2x* what men do. She isn't disorganised.
Hand off one whole *category* tonight, the noticing and remembering included. Then take a 20-minute walk.
phrases: He owns all of it — spotting it, planning it, doing it.
Not a task he does when reminded. The whole thing.
Then walk 20 minutes. WHO asks for 150 a week.
